responsibility: Provides the shared trait-error reporting framework for `rustc_trait_selection`, organizing fulfillment, ambiguity, overflow, and suggestion submodules, tracking previously reported trait errors for deduplication and prioritization, and exposing helper types and utilities used across trait diagnostics such as candidate similarity, span-based HIR lookup, and dyn-compatibility reporting.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the inference-oriented `mod.rs` files, this one is the trait-diagnostics coordinator: it organizes fulfillment/overflow/ambiguity reporting, deduplicates reported trait errors, and provides shared helpers for trait-specific diagnostics rather than generic type-inference error plumbing.
